model: continuous multisine with exact retarded time and assigned 1/r gain; independent Gaussian sensor noise; no room, speech or device recording
rng: PCG64; 32 phases then channel-major noise samples
emission_envelope: linear 20-ms onset/end; fade out .8-.82 s, zero .82-1.08 s, fade in 1.08-1.10 s
pcm: 16-bit little endian; codes.chapters.ch00.core.audio_samples.pcm16_bytes; decoded /32768; export gain undone only for fixed RMS gate

analysis_config.measurement_timestamp: receiver window center only when GCC observation is valid; otherwise null
analysis_config.last_valid_measurement_timestamp: most recent valid GCC window center; null before initialization and unchanged across missing frames
analysis_config.gcc: gcc_phat(ch1, ch0), tau10=t1-t0; max_tau=.1/343; parabolic interpolation; no truth input
analysis_config.update_order: initialize once; thereafter predict each 10 ms then update only with valid observation
analysis_config.truth: array-center retarded emission direction; tau10 compares the same emission event at both mics
analysis_config.scope: one fixed synthetic sequence; overlapping observations are correlated; assigned R/Q are not calibrated coverage; no identity or beamformer output
